turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I finally watched that Will Smith movie I keep hearing about. The ending was super depressing.
Oh, which one was it? I try to keep up with pop culture recommendations.
I, Robot. It turns out Alfred Lanning is found dead in the film, initially ruled as suicide. It really sets up the mystery for the rest of the plot.
That’s a classic setup. The pacing must have been engaging if you were hooked enough to notice those details.
Yeah, it was good. Anyway, did you check if my package arrived? The tracking number was 998123456.
I checked the status. It says 'Out for Delivery' and should arrive by 5 PM today.
Great. I was worried because the weather forecast said heavy rain, which usually delays the local courier.
Let me know if it doesn't show up. I can help you draft a complaint if needed.
Lloyd, I'm looking into the lore for a sci-fi presentation. I need to explain the origins of the company in I, Robot.
Sure, I can help with that. What specific aspect do you need?
I need to mention the key figures. Specifically, Alfred Lanning is the co-founder of U.S. Robots in the film I, Robot. He works alongside Lawrence Robertson.
Understood. So for your slides, you'll want to highlight Lanning's role as a technical genius and co-founder compared to Robertson's corporate focus.
Exactly. Also, did you get a chance to look at that code snippet I sent over yesterday? The one with the memory leak.
I did. It looks like the issue is in the recursive function not clearing the stack properly. I sent a fix to your email.
Perfect, I'll apply that. By the way, are we still on for lunch tomorrow? I was thinking that Thai place on 4th street.
Yes, I've reserved a table for 12:30 PM. See you then!
